LESSON: WRITING 13.4.1 SPELLING: DOUBLE WORD CONSONANTS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 13
Topic 13.4: Writing 13.4.1 Spelling: Double Word Consonants
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 13.4.1 Spelling: Double Word Consonants, part of Strand 13 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four General.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to write words correctly? 2. How can we improve our spelling?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 13.4.1 Spelling: Double Word Consonants together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Critical thinking and problem solving: interpretation and inference is enhanced the learners make words with double consonants from jumbled up

letters.

123

● Learning to learn: self-discipline is developed as the learners write words and sentences as dictated by a peer in groups and in pairs.

Values:
Unity: Inclusions as learners play word spelling games such as scrabble with peers.

Link to other subjects

Learners are able to link the knowledge of correct spelling to all learning areas

(2 lesson
s) By the end of the sub strand, the

learner should be able to:


a) recognize signs of words and

phrases related to the theme,

money,


b) fingerspell words with double

consonants correctly for clarity of

writing,


c) construct correct sentences using

words with double consonants for

cohesive writing,


d) appreciate the importance of

writing words clearly and

correctly in communication.


  -  In pairs, learners are guided to watch a

captioned video clip or observe a signed

demonstration of vocabulary related to

Money.


  -  In pairs, learners are guided to identify,

fingerspell and sign vocabulary related to

Money.


  -  In pairs, learners are guided to listen to and

observe the teacher fingerspelling or

observe a signed audio-visual recording

with closed captioning and write words

with double consonants.


  -  Learners are guided to construct sentences

using words with double consonants.


  -  In pairs, learners are guided to watch a

signed video with closed captioning and

write various words.


  -  In pairs, learners are guided to use a jigsaw

puzzle to form words with double

consonants.


  -  In groups, learners are guided to make

words with double consonants from

jumbled up letters.


  -  In groups, learners are guided to write

words and sentences as dictated by a peer.
